response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio AS average, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_from_overall_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY p.rating

assumptions.assumption: 'Replacement-cost cutoff of 20.99' selects films with replacement_cost >= 20.99 (at or above the cutoff); the request does not say whether the cutoff is inclusive or whether it selects films above or below it.
Films with NULL rating are excluded from the grouping (the verified data shows 5 rating levels).
The overall mean is the unweighted mean of per-rating averages, not weighted by film count.
